rules.description: Triggers Lambda for emergency calling when temperature >= 100°F
Triggers push notification for high temperature (threshold based)
rules.sql: SELECT *, 'temp' AS alertType FROM 'sws-data' WHERE tempF >= 70

rules.description: Triggers push notification for high humidity (threshold based)
rules.sql: SELECT *, 'hum' AS alertType FROM 'sws-data' WHERE hum >= 60

rules.description: Triggers push notification for poor air quality (threshold based)
rules.sql: SELECT *, 'air' AS alertType FROM 'sws-data' WHERE air >= 800

rules.description: Triggers push notification for low light (threshold based)
rules.sql: SELECT *, 'light' AS alertType FROM 'sws-data' WHERE light <= 200

notes.setup: Replace REGION and ACCOUNT_ID with your AWS region and account ID
notes.thresholds: IoT Rules have base thresholds, but per-user thresholds are checked in Lambda
notes.priority: CRITICAL rules trigger emergency calls, NORMAL rules trigger push notifications
